current: A plain centred card ('Tidig testversion' / 'Handball Manager Alpha') with one code input blocks every route; the default code ships in the client bundle, so the gate is cosmetic.
reason: The gate should disappear for public builds; while it exists it should cost one tap and already feel like the game. Folding it into the arena splash keeps the first impression branded without building a second title screen.

alternatives.name: Ticket at the turnstile
alternatives.concept: The gate becomes the first frame of the title screen: dimmed arena backdrop, wordmark, and a small 'Ange testkod' ticket stub that tears away on success and reveals ENT-02 underneath.
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed ENT-02 backdrop blurred at 60%; centred ticket card (360px) with code field, Lås upp button and a one-line explanation of the alpha + where codes come from.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Wordmark 2) code field 3) what the alpha is / how to get a code.
alternatives.interactions: Autofocus field, Enter submits, inline error (role=alert kept), success = ticket tear (200 ms, crossfade under reduced motion) into the title screen.
alternatives.navigation: Wraps the root layout as today; hands straight to ENT-02 with no reload. Env-gated wrapper so public builds skip it entirely.
alternatives.desktop: Ticket centred over blurred arena; title-screen buttons visible but inert behind it.
alternatives.mobile: Ticket docks to bottom third as a sheet so the keyboard does not cover the field; wordmark stays on top.
pros: First impression is the product, not a form
cons: Still a client-side cosmetic gate unless moved server-side

m: Bottom sheet: code field + Lås upp|form

alternatives.name: Tester welcome letter
alternatives.concept: An editorial 'letter to testers' page: what is being tested this build, known issues, how feedback works, and the code field as the signature line.
alternatives.layout: Two columns: left letter (kicker, headline, 3 short paragraphs, known-issues list); right code card + feedback promise.
alternatives.interactions: Code submit; collapsible known-issues; link to feedback (ENT-11).
alternatives.navigation: On success goes to ENT-02; content of the letter re-openable from ENT-11 help menu.
alternatives.mobile: Single column, code card first, letter below.

current: Two-column hero: tagline, big HANDBALL MANAGER wordmark and a row of 12 procedural crests on the left; four large text buttons (NYTT SPEL / FORTSÄTT / LADDA SPEL / INSTÄLLNINGAR) on the right over a faint SVG court outline; internal 'GAME EXPERIENCE v2' footer.
reason: Most sessions start here with an existing career, so the title screen should be about *your* club's current story, not a generic menu. Journal Cover makes Continue the hero with real state (week, next fixture, last result) while degrading gracefully to a new-player welcome; Arena Title is the stronger pick if the owner chooses identity B.
dependencies: Save summary metadata (club, season, next fixture, last result)

alternatives.name: Career Library
alternatives.concept: The title screen *is* your shelf of careers: the most recent save is a large 'resume' card, other saves are smaller cards, and New Game is the last card in the row. Menu items shrink to a quiet top-right utility row.
alternatives.layout: Top utility row (wordmark left; Inställningar, Ladda fil right). Main: hero resume card (8 cols: crest, club, 'Säsong 2026/27 · Omg 12', table position, last result, next fixture) + 'what happened since you left' list (4 cols). Below: card row of other saves + '+ Ny karriär' card.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Fortsätt as Tumba HK (resume card) 2) since-you-left digest 3) other careers / new career.
alternatives.interactions: Enter = Fortsätt; arrow keys move across save cards; hover on a card shows mini season chart; '…' on a card opens Ladda / Exportera / Ta bort (routes to ENT-04a pattern).
alternatives.navigation: Replaces most of ENT-04 for players with ≤4 saves; "Alla karriärer" link to ENT-04 for more. New-game card → ENT-03, Fortsätt → DSH-01.
alternatives.desktop: Light, dense, keyboard-first; 12-col grid, no imagery beyond crests and a position sparkline.
alternatives.mobile: Resume card fills first screen with a thumb-zone 'Fortsätt' button; other saves as a horizontal snap row; utility row collapses to a ⋯ menu.
pros: Fastest path back into the game (one key)
Shows real state, kills the "which save was that?" problem
Removes the need to visit Load Game for most players
cons: Least atmospheric first impression for new players
Needs save metadata (last result, position) cached at save time — needs new data: save-summary snapshot

d: Resume card: club, season, next match|8|hero

alternatives.name: Arena Title
alternatives.concept: A cinematic broadcast opener: the last-played club's arena photograph in floodlight, its crest flying in, club colours tinting the light beams; menu is a broadcast lower-third. New players see a neutral Swedish handball arena and a crest wall of all playable clubs.
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed arena media; bottom-left lower-third with wordmark + club line; right edge vertical menu of 4 broadcast tabs (angled corners); ticker along the bottom with since-you-left headlines.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Arena + crest (emotion) 2) FORTSÄTT tab with club name 3) ticker news.
alternatives.interactions: Ambient light sweep (paused under reduced motion); hover on menu tab previews (e.g. hovering Ladda spel fans out save crests); click Fortsätt triggers a camera push-in to DSH-01.
alternatives.navigation: Same 4 destinations as today; Fortsätt → DSH-01 with shared-element crest; Ladda → ENT-04 Arena variant.
alternatives.desktop: Video-game title feel; 16:9 hero, menu on the right third.
alternatives.mobile: Portrait crop of arena with crest centred; menu as stacked full-width broadcast bars at the bottom; ticker hidden.
pros: Strongest emotional pull and screenshot value
Club colours make it personal immediately
cons: Asset hungry (per-club arena imagery needed for full effect — needs new data: arena image per club or fallback set)

d: Menu tabs: Fortsätt / Nytt / Ladda / Inställningar|5|nav

alternatives.name: Journal Cover
alternatives.concept: The title screen is the cover of your club's journal for this week: masthead 'HANDBALL MANAGER', issue line 'Vecka 12 · 2026/27', a lead headline generated from state ('Tumba reser till Kristianstad efter tre raka segrar'), a framed arena photo, and Fortsätt as the cover's call to action. No save → cover welcomes you: 'Välj din klubb. Skriv din historia.'
alternatives.layout: Masthead row; main split 7/5: left lead headline + standfirst + Fortsätt CTA, right framed photo with crest stamp; bottom strip of three briefs (last result, table position, next fixture) and a quiet menu line (Ny karriär · Alla karriärer · Inställningar).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Headline about your club 2) Fortsätt 3) briefs and secondary menu.
alternatives.interactions: Fortsätt primary; 'Byt karriär' opens a small cover-flip of other saves (each save is a cover); paper→floodlight dim on Fortsätt as the transition into the career.
alternatives.navigation: Fortsätt → DSH-01 (Today's Paper continues the metaphor); Alla karriärer → ENT-04; Ny karriär → ENT-03.
alternatives.desktop: Paper surface, editorial grid, one curated photo.
alternatives.mobile: Vertical cover: masthead, photo, headline, Fortsätt pinned at the bottom; briefs as a 3-item list; menu line under it.
pros: Answers 'where was I?' in one sentence
Cheaper than B (one photo, no motion system)
Distinctive — no competitor uses a cover
cons: Headline generation needs good copy templates
needs new data: save-summary snapshot (last result, position, next fixture) readable without opening the full save

d: Briefs: last result · position · next match|9|cards

current: Six-step CareerEntryFrame (Nationer → Ligor → Databas → Klubb → Manager → Starta) with a numbered left rail, choice-card grids in the centre, a live context column (126px crest, club facts, manager pass, world counters) and a sticky Back/Next footer.
reason: Club choice is how the player identifies with their club, so it must come first and feel like a decision, not step 4 of a database wizard. 'Club first, contract last' collapses the six steps into three emotional beats (club → manager → signing) while keeping the world configuration available as an advanced drawer.
dependencies: Club preseason context (predicted, expectation, strengthVsLeague, economyLabel)

alternatives.name: Single-screen Setup Console
alternatives.concept: Everything on one scrollable page with a sticky summary: a club table you can sort by Förhandstips, Truppstyrka, Ekonomi; inline manager fields; preseason segmented control; Starta karriär in the summary bar. Power users finish in 30 seconds.
alternatives.layout: Left 8 cols: sortable club table (crest, club, serie, ort, arena, tips, förväntan, styrka ±, ekonomi). Right 4 cols sticky: selected club card + manager fields + preseason segmented control + Starta. 'Världen' (nations/leagues) collapsed above the table.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Club table 2) selected club summary 3) manager + start.
alternatives.interactions: Sort/filter the table; arrow keys move selection, summary updates live; Världen drawer for nations/leagues with a live count of playable clubs.
alternatives.navigation: From ENT-02; Starta → ENT-12 → DSH-01. No step rail.
alternatives.mobile: Club list as ranked cards (crest, name, tips, styrka); a bottom sheet holds manager + preseason + Starta once a club is picked.
pros: Comparing clubs on real numbers is easy
cons: No ceremony — the club choice feels like a filter result

d: Sticky: club card · manager · preseason · Starta|4|form

alternatives.name: Draft Night
alternatives.concept: A broadcast "choose your team" sequence: a crest wall of every playable club in its own colours; selecting one swings the camera into that club's arena with a broadcast lower-third of facts; then a locker-room manager card; then a signing ceremony.
alternatives.layout: Step 1 full-bleed crest wall grouped Handbollsligan / Allsvenskan; Step 2 arena hero with club stats as broadcast graphics; Step 3 manager card on dark glass; Step 4 signing ceremony.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Crests in club colours 2) selected club spotlight 3) proceed.
alternatives.interactions: Hover a crest lights it; click → spotlight transition; L/R to browse club spotlights; Välj klubben locks in; skippable motion.
alternatives.navigation: Linear 4 beats with a progress bug top-left; back always available; advanced world settings via gear icon.
alternatives.mobile: Swipeable full-screen club cards (one club per card, colour field + crest + 3 key facts); swipe up to select.
pros: Maximum identification with the chosen club
Clubs differentiated by colour and arena at a glance
cons: Comparing clubs on numbers is harder
Needs arena imagery per club (needs new data: per-club arena photo or styled fallback)

alternatives.name: Club first, contract last
alternatives.concept: Three beats instead of six: 1 'Välj din hemmaplan' (club choice, with world settings as an advanced drawer), 2 'Vem är du?' (manager), 3 'Kontraktet' (preseason length + signing). The right context column becomes a growing club journal page that fills as you choose.
alternatives.layout: Top: 3-step progress line (Klubb · Manager · Kontrakt). Centre 8 cols: step content. Right 4 cols: living journal page (crest, club headline, facts, then manager byline, then mandate). Sticky footer Back / Next.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) The club decision 2) the journal page reflecting it 3) Next.
alternatives.interactions: Step 1 offers three lenses on the same clubs (ambition chips: Överleva / Utmana / Vinna; league toggle HBL/Allsvenskan); world settings drawer shows playable-club count; 'Signera' on step 3 triggers the ENT-03f signing moment.
alternatives.navigation: From ENT-02 Ny karriär; finishes into ENT-12 (club-themed loading) → DSH-01. Nations/leagues/Databas live in the drawer (ENT-03a/b/c merged).
alternatives.desktop: Paper three-zone frame kept (low migration cost) but with 3 steps and a richer right column.
alternatives.mobile: Step content full-width; the journal page becomes a collapsible header card showing crest + club name; footer CTA thumb-reachable.
pros: Context column becomes a story, not a dl
cons: Advanced users must open the drawer to change nations

current: Step 1 of the wizard: a grid of checkbox cards per nation (flag + code, name, '# ligor i urvalet', ✓ Vald / + Välj) plus a note card.
reason: Only Swedish clubs are playable, so nation selection is a world-size setting, not a first decision. It belongs in an advanced 'Världen' drawer with sensible defaults.

alternatives.name: 'Världen' advanced drawer
alternatives.concept: Nation selection moves into a right-side drawer opened from a 'Världen: 3 nationer · 5 ligor' chip on the club step; defaults pre-selected.
alternatives.layout: Drawer 420px: nation list with toggles and league count; footer shows simulated-world size (clubs, players).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Defaults summary chip 2) nation toggles 3) world size.
alternatives.interactions: Toggle rows; Återställ standard; closing updates playable-club count on the club step.
alternatives.navigation: Opened from ENT-03d toolbar; never a step.
cons: Less discoverable for players who care about world size

alternatives.name: World map selector
alternatives.concept: A stylised Europe map where nations light up when included; a counter shows leagues and clubs simulated.
alternatives.interactions: Click a country to toggle; hover shows its leagues.
alternatives.navigation: Inside the Världen drawer or as an optional screen.
alternatives.mobile: List fallback (map too small to tap reliably).
cons: Map asset for a low-stakes setting

current: Step 2: per-nation sections of league cards showing tier as a zero-padded number ('01'), club count and playable-club count; empty-state note when none is playable.
reason: A pyramid makes the Swedish system (Handbollsligan over Allsvenskan, with kval between) legible and doubles as a teaching moment, while staying inside the advanced drawer.

alternatives.name: League pyramid
alternatives.concept: Each nation's leagues drawn as a stacked pyramid: Handbollsligan on top, Allsvenskan below, with kval arrows between tiers; playable tiers marked with a crest count.
alternatives.layout: One pyramid per nation, stacked; toggle on each tier row.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Tier names 2) playable clubs 3) promotion/relegation links.
alternatives.interactions: Toggle a tier; hover the kval arrow explains promotion/relegation (glossary tooltip).
alternatives.navigation: Inside Världen drawer; changes update ENT-03d immediately.
alternatives.mobile: Stacked tier rows with indent by tier.
cons: Needs promotion/relegation links per tier (exists for Sweden; other nations unverified)

alternatives.name: Inline league chips on the club step
alternatives.concept: No league screen at all: league chips (Handbollsligan · Allsvenskan · +) sit above the club grid and filter it; adding non-Swedish leagues is in the Världen drawer.
alternatives.interactions: Toggle chips filters and includes leagues at once.
cons: Conflates "include in world" with "filter the list"

current: Step 3 'Databas': four MiniStat counters, the list of selected competitions and an explanatory note; asks nothing of the player.
reason: A step with no decision should not exist. Its counts are useful as a footer of the world drawer.

alternatives.name: Fold into drawer footer
alternatives.concept: Remove the step; the four counters (nationer, ligor, klubbar, spelare) become a one-line footer in the Världen drawer and a tooltip on the 'Världen' chip.
alternatives.interactions: None beyond tooltip.
cons: Loses the "this is a big world" moment

alternatives.name: World-building beat in the loading screen
alternatives.concept: Move the counters into ENT-12 while the world is generated ('Bygger 84 klubbar, 1 400 spelare…'), turning dead loading time into the summary.
alternatives.hierarchy: Secondary to club crest on ENT-12.
alternatives.interactions: Passive.
cons: Counts shown after the choice can no longer change

current: Step 4: toolbar with count, a radio-card grid of ~30 near-identical text cards (48px crest, name, league, city · venue, heritage tag, 'Tips: 7:a · förväntan'), and a <details> list of non-playable clubs; the real differentiators (Truppstyrka mot serien, Ekonomi, Styrelsens förväntan) only appear in the right column after selection.
reason: This is how the player identifies with their club. The ambition-led Club Wall puts club colour and identity first, shows the real differentiators on every tile, and frames the choice as a challenge type (Överleva / Utmana / Vinna) — the 'scenario with three goals' pattern built purely from existing preseason context.
dependencies: Club preseason context (predicted, clubsInLeague, expectation, strengthVsLeague, economyLabel)

alternatives.name: Comparison table + spotlight
alternatives.concept: A sortable club table with every differentiator as a column, inline bars for Truppstyrka ± and Ekonomi, and a spotlight card on the right for the selected row.
alternatives.layout: Table 8 cols (crest, klubb, serie, ort, arena · platser, tips x/14, förväntan, styrka ± bar, ekonomi); spotlight 4 cols (126px crest, heritage line, facts, Välj).
alternatives.interactions: Sort any column; filter HBL/Allsvenskan; arrow keys + Enter; compare two clubs by shift-click (side-by-side spotlight).
alternatives.mobile: Ranked cards with crest, name, tips and styrka bar; tap = spotlight bottom sheet.
cons: Feels like a spreadsheet at the most emotional moment

alternatives.name: Map of Sweden
alternatives.concept: Clubs placed on a stylised map of Sweden as crest pins in club colours; clustering in Skåne, Stockholm, Göteborg tells the geography of Swedish handball. Selecting a pin opens a club postcard (arena, capacity, founded, heritage, tips).
alternatives.layout: Map 7 cols (tall), postcard 5 cols; league toggle overlay.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Where in Sweden 2) the club postcard 3) Välj.
alternatives.interactions: Zoom into regions; pins filter by league; rivals within 50 km highlighted (derby hint).
alternatives.mobile: Map as top half with region chips; postcards swipe horizontally beneath.

d: Map of Sweden with crest pins|7|media

alternatives.name: Club Wall by ambition
alternatives.concept: Every playable club is a colour tile (primary colour field, secondary stripe, crest, name, town) grouped by the challenge it offers — 'Vinna' (tipped top 3), 'Utmana' (mid-table, strength ≈ 0), 'Överleva' (tipped bottom / Allsvenskan climbers). Each tile shows three micro-meters: Förväntan, Truppstyrka ±, Ekonomi.
alternatives.layout: Top: ambition tabs + league toggle. Grid of colour tiles (4 per row desktop). Right 4 cols: living journal page that expands the selected club (heritage line, arena, founded, board expectation in a quote, Seriestart).
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Colour + crest (recognition) 2) ambition group (what kind of story) 3) micro-meters (informed choice).
alternatives.interactions: Hover tile = club colour floods the journal page header; click selects; 'Jämför' pins up to 3 tiles for a side-by-side; non-playable clubs shown greyed in an 'Övriga klubbar i världen' strip.
alternatives.navigation: Next → ENT-03e; the selected club's colours tint the rest of the wizard.
alternatives.mobile: Ambition tabs sticky; tiles 2 per row; tapping a tile expands it in place to show facts and a Välj button.
pros: Club identity first, numbers second but present
Ambition framing cures blank-slate paralysis without new gameplay
cons: Club secondary colour may need curating for poor-contrast pairs

current: Step 5: three form fields (name, nationality select, date of birth) beside a 'Tränarbänken' pass card showing an initials monogram.
reason: The manager pass is a strong existing metaphor; making it a credential the player fills in (with optional coaching philosophy as flavour) gives identity without inventing gameplay. A philosophy choice must stay cosmetic until a system exists.

alternatives.name: Plain form, live pass
alternatives.concept: Keep the three fields but make the pass card update live and larger; add a monogram colour taken from the chosen club.
alternatives.interactions: Typing updates pass; nationality flag appears.

alternatives.name: Accreditation pass
alternatives.concept: The manager fills in a sports-federation accreditation: photo slot (monogram or chosen avatar style), name, nationality, date of birth, and an optional 'Tränarfilosofi' line (e.g. 'Snabba omställningar', '6-0 och tålamod') printed on the pass as flavour text.
alternatives.layout: Large pass centred (credit-card ratio, club colours, lanyard), fields edit directly on the pass.
alternatives.interactions: Click a field on the pass to edit in place; avatar style picker (monogram / silhouette variants); philosophy chosen from a short list or skipped.
alternatives.navigation: → ENT-03f; the pass reappears in MGR-01 and the ENT-03f signing.
alternatives.desktop: Pass at 480px over the club-coloured background.
alternatives.mobile: Pass full-width, fields as stacked inputs under it.
cons: Philosophy is cosmetic — must be labelled so (needs new data: stored philosophy string)

alternatives.name: Press release byline
alternatives.concept: The manager step is a draft press release from the chosen club: '[Klubben] presenterar [namn] som ny huvudtränare'. The player fills the blanks; a quote line is optional.
alternatives.layout: Editorial article 8 cols with inline fill-in fields; right 4 cols the club crest and date.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Headline with your name 2) club 3) fields.
alternatives.interactions: Inline fields in text; preview toggles.
alternatives.navigation: → ENT-03f; the release later seeds the first WLD-02 news item.
alternatives.mobile: Article full width; fields remain inline but larger.
cons: needs new data: first news item seeded from manager creation
Form fields in prose are less scannable

current: Step 6: mandate banner ('Ditt uppdrag · 2026/27', manager name 'tar plats hos' club, 84px crest), radio grid of five preseason options with dates (8/6/4/2 weeks or first match) and a summary dl, then STARTA KARRIÄR.
reason: The start of a career should be a moment. The signing ceremony uses the existing DEAL_SIGNED backdrop, keeps the preseason choice as a clear decision with dates, and makes STARTA a signature rather than a submit.

alternatives.name: Mandate summary
alternatives.concept: A clean confirmation: club + manager header, preseason as a horizontal timeline from today to Seriestart with the 5 options as stops, summary list, Starta.
alternatives.interactions: Drag/click stop on timeline; shows training weeks and friendlies window.
pros: Preseason length becomes understandable in time

alternatives.name: Signing ceremony
alternatives.concept: Floodlight moment on the DEAL_SIGNED backdrop: the contract document (club crest, 'Huvudtränare', season 2026/27, board expectation quote) with the preseason choice as a clause; the player signs by pressing and holding 'Signera' — then flash and crest stamp.
alternatives.layout: Full-bleed backdrop; centred contract card; clause section with 5 preseason radio chips and dates; signature line CTA.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Contract with club 2) preseason clause 3) Signera.
alternatives.interactions: Press-and-hold to sign (keyboard: hold Enter / or plain click under reduced motion); stamp animation; skippable.
alternatives.mobile: Contract scrolls; sticky signature bar at bottom.
cons: Hold-to-sign must have an accessible alternative

alternatives.name: Board's first meeting
alternatives.concept: Framed as the first board meeting: the chair states expectation (from preseason context), budget label and a target; the manager answers by choosing preseason length ('Jag vill ha 6 veckor').
alternatives.layout: Dialogue column 8 (board portrait monogram + speech), response options 4.
alternatives.interactions: Choose a response = preseason option.
pros: Sets season stakes as a ritual
cons: Risk of fake choice framing; must stay presentation only

current: Same three-zone frame as New Game: rail with save count; a 6-column table (Manager, Klubb, Säsong, Speldatum as raw ISO, Senast spelad, actions); right context column with 126px crest, manager, facts and next match; delete is a two-step inline row.
reason: Saves are careers, i.e. stories — cards with club colour, season progress and last result are far easier to recognise than a table row. Journal Cover keeps the B/C metaphor consistent with the title screen; Career Library (A) is the recommended fallback if the title screen goes A.

alternatives.name: Career Library
alternatives.concept: Saves as a sortable list of career rows with crest, club, manager, season progress bar (omgång 12/26), table position and last-played; selected row expands to a preview panel.
alternatives.layout: List 8 cols, preview 4 cols; toolbar with sort (Senast spelad / Klubb) and Importera fil.
alternatives.interactions: Arrow keys + Enter to load; ⋯ menu Exportera / Ta bort; drag a .json file anywhere to import.
alternatives.mobile: List rows only; tap = preview bottom sheet with Ladda.
pros: Formatted dates and progress instead of ISO

alternatives.name: Arena Title
alternatives.concept: Saves as a carousel of club 'jerseys' / crest banners in club colours in a dark arena; centred card shows season, position, last result; Ladda is a broadcast button.
alternatives.layout: Horizontal carousel centred; info lower-third; actions row.
alternatives.interactions: L/R arrows/swipe; Enter loads; hold Delete for ENT-04a.

alternatives.name: Journal Cover
alternatives.concept: Each save is a journal cover on a shelf: masthead in club colours, the latest headline from that career, issue line ('Vecka 12 · 2026/27 · 3:a i HBL'). Select to open a spread with the last 5 results and next fixture.
alternatives.layout: Shelf grid of covers (3-4 per row); selected cover opens a right spread 5 cols.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) Covers (club colour + headline) 2) selected spread 3) Fortsätt karriären.
alternatives.interactions: Click cover → spread; Fortsätt; ⋯ Exportera / Ta bort (ENT-04a confirm with export offer); '+ Ny karriär' is a blank cover.
alternatives.mobile: Covers as a vertical list of half-height cards; spread as full-screen sheet.
pros: Every save remembered by its story
cons: needs new data: save-summary snapshot (latest headline, last results)

current: An extra full-width table row with the question, club · date and two buttons (Behåll karriären / Ta bort karriären); deletion is permanent with no export prompt.
reason: A permanent, unrecoverable delete deserves a real dialog that names what is lost and offers export first.

alternatives.name: Consequence dialog with export
alternatives.concept: Modal that shows the club crest, season and play time, states 'Kan inte ångras', and offers 'Exportera först' as the primary safe action next to a destructive 'Ta bort'.
alternatives.layout: Small dialog: crest + summary, consequence line, buttons Exportera först · Behåll · Ta bort.
alternatives.hierarchy: 1) What is deleted 2) Exportera först 3) Ta bort.
alternatives.interactions: Esc/Behåll closes; Ta bort requires typing club short name only for saves >1 season (optional).
alternatives.mobile: Bottom sheet with stacked buttons, destructive last.

alternatives.name: Soft delete with undo
alternatives.concept: Deleting moves the save to 'Papperskorg' for 7 days with an Ångra toast; permanent deletion happens later or from the bin.
alternatives.layout: Toast + bin section at the bottom of ENT-04.
alternatives.interactions: Ångra within toast; restore from bin.
cons: needs new data: deletedAt flag on saves

current: Text blocks in the centre column (overline + heading + paragraph) for loading, empty and error; the context column swaps to matching copy; no skeletons.
reason: Skeletons matching the chosen save layout remove layout jump; the empty state should be an invitation to the club choice, not a dead end.

alternatives.name: Skeleton saves + invitation
alternatives.concept: Loading = 3 skeleton save cards in final layout; empty = one large '+ Ny karriär' card with a teaser of the club wall (row of crests); error = card explaining IndexedDB in plain Swedish with Försök igen and Exportera-help link.
alternatives.hierarchy: Loading: shape; Empty: CTA; Error: cause + retry.
alternatives.interactions: Retry; Skapa en karriär.

alternatives.name: Locker room states
alternatives.concept: Empty = empty locker room photo with 'Ingen har hängt upp sin tröja här än' and Ny karriär; error = dim arena with the error and retry.
alternatives.interactions: CTA buttons.

current: A simple page with header and three plain sections: Valuta (EUR/SEK as link-styled radios), Matchhastighet select and an explanatory note; diverges from the in-career settings page (SYS-01).
reason: One settings component used in and out of career removes the divergence and is the natural home for density, text size and reduced motion — accessibility settings that matter more than currency.

alternatives.name: Unified settings panel
alternatives.concept: One settings component with sections Visning (density, textstorlek, rörelse, tema), Match (standardhastighet), Ekonomi (valuta with live sample amount), Data (export/import moved here); used on /settings and /career/settings.
alternatives.layout: Left section nav 3 cols, content 9 cols with grouped rows (label, control, live preview).
alternatives.interactions: Instant apply; reset per section; real radio inputs.
alternatives.navigation: Out of career from ENT-02; in career from user menu (ENT-08) — same component.
cons: needs new data: persisted density/text-size/motion prefs

alternatives.name: Settings sheet over title
alternatives.concept: Settings open as a side sheet over the title screen instead of a separate page, so the arena/cover stays visible behind and changes (e.g. theme, density) preview live on it.
alternatives.interactions: Sheet open/close; live preview behind.

alternatives.name: Manager's preferences card
alternatives.concept: Settings presented as a short 'så vill jag ha det' card with 4 plain-language toggles and an Avancerat expander.

dependencies: Stop-reason type taxonomy (match, board, press, transfer, injury, deadline)
